work.abstract_text: For Peter Bala's conjecture in the comment of 16 February 2026 in OEIS A281183, revision 60 of 6 November 2026, we give explicit onsets and an alternative lifting proof of Lien-Hung Su's period theorem of 31 October 2026, Theorem 3.2 and Corollary 3.3 of Quadratic Derivations and Uniform Modular Periods for Six Inverse-Function Sequences, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23835577. If a_n=(2n)![x^(2n)]C(x)^2, where C=cosh(integral_0^x C(t)^3 dt), then a_n is integral and has an eventual period dividing phi(m)^2 for every positive modulus m. For m>=3, phi(m)^2/2 is a period after N(m)=max(v_2(m), max_{odd p|m} ceil(v_p(m)/2)). A binomial operator lift proves this for every integral formal-series observable of S'=(1+S^2)^2. The note proves companion and interleaving consequences and gives dimension-bounded certificates for seven residue periods and the mod-12 identity, crediting Su's prior proofs. Written proofs, finite coefficient comparisons and formal declaration coverage are distinguished.

work.title: Explicit onsets and residue certificates for Bala's totient-square period problem after Su
